description.text: Efficient and rapid intensive teaching mode, in which general Chinese teaching adopts centralized intensive language training mode, and specialized Chinese and specialized basic knowledge (mathematics, physics and chemistry, etc.) teaching adopts complementary habit education, which focuses on teaching core knowledge of related disciplines.We offer Chinese language courses based on skills to comprehensively improve students' listening, speaking, reading and writing skills, and provide HSK pre-test guidance, training and simulation tests.According to the discipline characteristics and professional requirements of the University of International Business and Economics (UIBE), we offer Chinese courses for bridging business courses, and math and English courses in the spring semester.Free experience of the "Business Chinese self-study and self-test system" independently developed by the college, a two-way combination of classroom learning and practical application.

duration.text: The Foundation Programs at University of International Business and Economics is a 1 Semester long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2166 USD/per semester ￥ 15600 CNY/per semester

materials.text: (Only in Chinese or English. No matter whether the applicant is accepted or not, the submitted application materials will not be returned.)1. University of International Business and Economics Application Form (online)2. Copy of final academic certificate and transcript3. Copy of identity document of guarantor in China4. Copy of guardian Notarial Certificate and guardian ID card (for applicants under 18 years old)5. Proof of assets (if necessary, e.g. Bank deposit certificate, the amount must exceed the tuition fee payable)6. No criminal proof (if required)7. Copy of the applicant's passport or ID card8. Two recent passport photos with white background without a crown

requirements.text: 1. Graduated from high school and are in good health.2. Students under the age of 18 must obtain the consent of the school and apply for the notarial certificate of guardian and other relevant documents
